name: The false nine decoy
engine: Oyarzabal is a false nine and a decoy: two reasons for a centre-back to follow him, and midfielders arrive unmarked to shoot.
about: The same pair as Decoy and receiver (Decoy from wave E, Nominated receiver from wave A) with wave D's No striker family. Oyarzabal plays as a false nine (link player, no striker keyword): a centre-back follows him short, so a midfielder who gets the ball at the edge of their box or in it is unmarked for the rest of the attack, and with nobody up front who only finishes, a midfielder's shot in their box is +2 and needs 3. The Decoy's marker still follows him: a move by anyone else against their defenders is +1 until he touches the ball. Cut-backs and low crosses go to Olmo, who needs 3 on his first touch of the attack (Fresh feet) and 2 when unmarked (Cool head). Two clean wins in a row give one more decision (Rhythm).
decisions: Keep the ball away from Oyarzabal: he is there to be followed.
Get a midfielder on the ball at the edge of their box: he is unmarked from then on.
Olmo's first touch is his best shot.
